instructions: Create these 5 new EggHatch records as 'active' status. Keep the existing 10 retired records. These are the current month's eggs for community voting.

items.contentDescription: A geode that hums at 42Hz when held to the ear. Players who find it hear fragments of the Archive's oldest texts — whispers from before the Inn was built.
questlineSteps: Transcribe what you hear in the Archive

items.contentDescription: A tiny mouse with a flame for a tail who lives behind the Common Room hearth. Trades warm stones for crumbs of bread. If you feed Pip enough, the hearth fire never goes out during your visit.

A puzzle mode where the Watcher gargoyle (111Hz) asks riddles drawn from the Archive's restricted texts. Each correct answer unlocks a new shelf. Wrong answers add a minute of silence to the Inn's ambient music.
questlineSteps: Answer correctly to unlock a shelf
Answer wrong to deepen the silence

items.contentDescription: A hidden tidal pool in the Water Zone that only appears at the Inn's simulated midnight. Stare into it and see your character's Shadow (84Hz) version — the self that stayed when you chose to grow.
questlineSteps: Find the tidal pool at midnight

items.contentDescription: A player-submitted character who claims to have mapped zones that don't exist yet — rooms above the Cosmology, tunnels below the Shadow Inn. The map is real. The question is whether the rooms are predictions or memories.
